# 🌱 Legume Nutrient Dashboard

**An interactive web application for analyzing legume nutritional data from the USDA FoodData Central API** 

Built for STAT 386 • Data Science & Analysis
:::

## 📊 Project Overview

This dashboard provides comprehensive analysis of legume nutritional profiles, featuring interactive visualizations and data insights from the [USDA Foundation Foods database](https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/food-search?type=Foundation&SFFoodCategory=Legumes%20and%20Legume%20Products).

## ✨ Key Features

- **Interactive Data Visualization** with radar charts and correlation analysis
- **USDA Data Integration** for real-time nutritional information
- **Comprehensive Legume Database** covering beans, lentils, peas, and more
- **Export Capabilities** for filtered datasets and analysis results

## 🛠️ Technology Stack

Built with modern data science tools: Python, Streamlit, Plotly, Pandas, and Quarto for documentation.
